question: 2026 年 1–3 月每个月的销售额分别是多少？三个月合计多少？

read_only_sql_calls.sql: SELECT MIN(order_date) AS min_date, MAX(order_date) AS max_date, COUNT(*) AS rows_all, COUNT(DISTINCT status) AS status_kinds FROM `xinghe_retail`.`orders`
read_only_sql_calls.description: 核对 orders 表日期范围与状态取值

read_only_sql_calls.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `xinghe_retail`.`orders` GROUP BY status ORDER BY cnt DESC
read_only_sql_calls.description: 查看订单状态取值分布

read_only_sql_calls.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.order_date, '%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt, SUM(d.pay_amount) AS sales_amount FROM `xinghe_retail`.`orders` AS d WHERE d.status = '已完成' AND d.order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND d.order_date < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(d.order_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ym
read_only_sql_calls.description: 按本体口径统计 2026 年 1-3 月每月销售额

read_only_sql_calls.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT order_no) AS distinct_order_no, SUM(pay_amount) AS total_sales FROM `xinghe_retail`.`orders` WHERE status = '已完成' AND order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-04-01'
read_only_sql_calls.description: 校验订单号唯一性并统计区间合计销售额

question: 云桥店 2026 年 1–3 月的销售额是多少？

read_only_sql_calls.sql: SELECT store_id, store_name, city, opened_on FROM `xinghe_retail`.`stores` ORDER BY store_id
read_only_sql_calls.description: 核对门店维度表门店编号唯一性

read_only_sql_calls.sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS sales_amount FROM `xinghe_retail`.`orders` AS o JOIN `xinghe_retail`.`stores` AS s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-04-01' AND s.store_id = 'S03' GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
read_only_sql_calls.description: 统计云桥店 2026 年 1-3 月销售额

read_only_sql_calls.sql: SELECT o.store_id, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS sales_amount, MAX(CASE WHEN s.store_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orphan_flag FROM `xinghe_retail`.`orders` AS o LEFT JOIN `xinghe_retail`.`stores` AS s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY o.store_id ORDER BY o.store_id
read_only_sql_calls.description: 校验各门店销售额分布与是否存在孤儿门店编号
